title: “From Self-Love to Self-Loss — The Gospel They Don’t Preach Anymore”
paragraphs:
“From Self-Love to Self-Loss — The Gospel They Don’t Preach Anymore”
(Because denying yourself doesn’t trend.)
📖 Anchored in Luke 9:23 — this scroll will expose the seduction of motivational Christianity and confront the rising cult of identity without crucifixion.

They said, “Love yourself.”
They said, “Be your best self.”
They said, “Jesus died so you could fulfill your dreams.”

But Jesus said something different:
“Deny yourself. Take up your cross. Follow Me.”

📛 One message flatters the flesh.
🔥 The other demands its funeral.

One message builds platforms.
The other builds altars.
You can’t preach the true Gospel and leave self alive.

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, isn’t it good to love myself and want to improve? What’s wrong with becoming a better me?"

✅ Answer:
Because Jesus didn’t call you to improve the old you — He called you to crucify it.

You weren’t called to be a better version of your past.
🔥 You were called to be a dead man walking… filled with the life of Christ.

📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE — Luke 9:23 (KJV)
“And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.”
🔗 Full URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-9-23/

💥 This is not motivational.
🔥 This is martyrdom.

The Gospel isn’t about personal improvement.
It’s about full surrender — daily.
CORE TRUTH — THE GOSPEL OF SELF-DENIAL, NOT SELF-IMPROVEMENT

📖 Luke 9:23 (KJV):
“And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.”
🔗 Full URL: https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-9-23/
🔍 GREEK BREAKDOWN:

Deny = ἀπαρνέομαι (aparnéomai)
💥 Definition: To utterly disown, reject, to disassociate from oneself entirely
🔥 Not “delay pleasure.” Not “self-control.”
📛 This means complete abandonment of self-rule, self-glory, self-will.

Cross = σταυρός (staurós)
💥 Definition: A Roman instrument of execution, a symbol of shame, public death, irreversible surrender
🔥 In 1st-century ears, “carry your cross” didn’t mean endure inconvenience.
It meant, “Go die now.”

Self = ἑαυτοῦ (heautou)
💥 Meaning: One’s ego, personal identity, soul-centered desires, plans, ambitions
🔥 This is the entire carnal self-life — not just bad habits.

📛 TODAY’S COUNTERFEIT PREACHING:
“Improve yourself, love yourself, find yourself.”

🧬 But Jesus said:
Kill the old you.
Deny the inner rebel.
Let Christ live instead.

📖 Galatians 2:20 (KJV):
“I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Galatians-2-20/

💥 Paul didn’t say “I improved with Christ.”
🔥 He said, “I died.”
"Brother John, is it wrong to pursue personal growth and healing?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Not if it’s led by the Holy Spirit and anchored in surrender.
📛 But when it becomes self-exaltation, self-obsession, or self-identity building — it’s no longer healing.
🔥 It’s a flesh revival pretending to be Christian maturity.

⚡ Summary Strike:
Jesus never came to improve you.
🔥 He came to crucify you — and raise a new creation from your ashes.
📛 If your gospel leaves you alive, it isn’t His.
BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — THE GOSPEL THAT KILLS THE FLESH

📖 Galatians 5:24 (KJV):
“And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Galatians-5-24/
💥 You don’t “manage” the flesh — you crucify it.

📖 Romans 8:13 (KJV):
“For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Romans-8-13/
🔥 The Gospel doesn’t coach the old you — it mortifies it.

📖 2 Timothy 3:1–2, 5 (KJV):
“This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come. For men shall be lovers of their own selves... Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Timothy-3-1_3-5/
📛 End-time deception isn’t atheism — it’s self-worship wrapped in religion.

📖 Matthew 16:25 (KJV):
“For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-16-25/

🔥 You don’t find yourself in the Gospel.
You lose yourself — and find Christ.
✝️ EARLY CHURCH TESTIMONY — SELF-DENIAL WAS NON-NEGOTIABLE

✝️ Ignatius of Antioch (Letter to the Romans, 107 A.D.):
“I am the wheat of God, and I am ground by the teeth of the wild beasts, that I may be found the pure bread of Christ.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0107.htm
🔥 Not “live your purpose.” But die to self.

✝️ Polycarp, Bishop of Smyrna (Martyrdom of Polycarp, Ch. 9):
“He prayed to be counted worthy to drink from the cup of Christ's suffering, refusing to escape death by denying Jesus.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0102.htm
🔥 The Early Church didn’t ask for upgrades — they asked for altars.

✝️ John Chrysostom (Homily 5 on Matthew):
“Nothing is more worthless than the soul that loves itself... It must be slain for Christ.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/200105.htm

📛 Today they preach “confidence.”
🔥 The Church Fathers preached crucifixion.
"Brother John, why do so few churches preach this Gospel today?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Because it doesn’t fill rooms.
📛 It doesn’t build brands.
🔥 It doesn’t sell conferences.

But it raises the dead.
It makes disciples — not consumers.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The Bible and the Church Fathers agree:
🔥 The real Gospel doesn’t celebrate you.
It crucifies you… and raises you with Christ.

RESURRECTION RESPONSE CODES
📛 Publicly renounce the self-idol gospel. Post these as banners of allegiance.
🧬 Resurrection Declarations:
🔊 “I don’t want to be my best self. I want to be my dead self — raised in Christ.”
🔊 “Self-love didn’t save me. The cross did.”
🔊 “Jesus didn’t die to make me successful — He died to make me surrendered.”
🔊 “The Gospel doesn’t improve me. It crucifies me.”
🔊 “Motivation might trend — but crucifixion transforms.”
🔊 “If it doesn’t lead to a cross, it’s not Christianity.”
🔊 “I renounce the idol of self. I choose death — that I might live.”
🔊 “The flesh will not lead my faith. The cross will.”
🔊 “Jesus, kill what still loves itself in me.”
🔊 “Real revival doesn’t build brands — it buries egos.”
📢 POST-READY FIRE DECLARATION (for Facebook/Instagram):

👉 “I’m not here to ‘become the best version of me.’ I’m here to die daily and live as Christ. I renounce the motivational gospel. I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR.”
🔥 #CrucifyTheFlesh #GospelWarrior #DeadToSelf #CrossOverCrowd #MotivationIsNotSalvation #SelfDenialRevival
📎 Remnant Group Link (Always Add):
"Brother John, can I still love myself and follow Jesus?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes — if your love leads to surrender, not self-worship.
📛 But when “self-love” resists the cross, it becomes spiritual idolatry.
🔥 Real love says, “I’m not mine anymore — I belong to Him.”

⚡ Summary Strike:
You weren’t called to self-esteem.
🔥 You were called to self-extinction — and to rise again with Christ.
OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS — DEATH TO SELF IS NOT NEW

📖 Genesis 22:2 (KJV):
“And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest... and offer him there for a burnt offering...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Genesis-22-2/

💥 Abraham didn’t just lay down his son.
🔥 He laid down himself — his legacy, promise, and personal dream.
📛 Self must die — even if it looks holy.

📖 Leviticus 1:9 (KJV):
“But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Leviticus-1-9/

💥 The entire offering had to burn.
🔥 No partial surrender. No improvement. Total consumption.
📛 The altar doesn’t fix you. It finishes you.

📖 Isaiah 6:5–7 (KJV):
“Woe is me! for I am undone... Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Isaiah-6-5_6-7/

💥 Isaiah wasn’t commissioned until he was undone.
🔥 Self had to shatter before Heaven could speak.

📖 Psalm 51:17 (KJV):
“The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Psalms-51-17/

📛 Not improved confidence. Not healed ego.
🔥 Brokenness is the sacrifice God never rejects.
"Brother John, did anyone in the Old Testament struggle with dying to self?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes — even kings and prophets wrestled.
📖 Moses was called to die to his past.
📖 Elijah wanted to die in his fear.
📖 Jonah refused to die to his opinions.
🔥 But every time self resisted, God brought fire, fish, or wilderness — until surrender won.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The Old Covenant didn’t prepare people for comfort.
🔥 It trained them for crucifixion — so when Christ came, the altar was already lit.
📛 Self never stood on holy ground and lived.

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “I WAS CHASING HEALING… BUT NEEDED A FUNERAL”
🧍‍♀️ Testimony: Melissa T. — From Self-Help to Self-Death

Melissa was a faithful churchgoer.
She journaled affirmations.
She read devotionals titled: “Becoming the Best You”
Her pastor said, “You’re royalty. You’re a queen. God is obsessed with your potential.”

And she believed it — until the anxiety got worse.
Until the depression came back.
Until all her “breakthrough declarations” left her burned out, not burning with fire.

She was following Jesus…
But the version she followed never demanded a cross.
Then she stumbled onto Luke 9:23.
“Deny yourself.”

That verse wrecked her.
She fasted for three days, asking: “Lord, what do You want from me?”
And He answered:
“I don’t want a better version of you. I want the dead version of you — so I can live instead.”

That week, she threw away the self-help books.
She stopped listening to “manifestation Christian influencers.”
She canceled the life coaching seminar she’d already paid for.

Now Melissa meets weekly with two other women in her apartment.
No ring lights. No affirmations.
Just tears, Bibles, and the cross.
🔥 Her new anthem?

“Jesus didn’t come to fix my broken mirror.
He came to shatter it — and make me reflect Him.”
"Brother John, what if I’ve built my entire walk around self-improvement and not surrender?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then it’s time for a personal funeral.
🔥 Don’t ask God to bless your better self.
Ask Him to crucify your old one — and raise up a vessel that’s no longer yours.

📖 Galatians 6:14 (KJV):
“…the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Galatians-6-14/

⚡ Summary Strike:
Melissa wasn’t weak.
She was just deceived by a gospel that preached healing without death.
🔥 Now she’s alive — because she finally died.
FINAL CHALLENGE — WHO STILL LIVES IN YOU?

📖 Luke 9:23 (KJV):
“If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-9-23/

💥 You don’t follow Jesus by adding Him to your personality.
🔥 You follow Him by burying your personality at the cross.

📖 Colossians 3:3 (KJV):
“For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Colossians-3-3/

📛 That’s not self-help.
🔥 That’s self-extinction.
🧱 UNCOMFORTABLE TRUTH:

✔️ You can attend church and never die to self.
✔️ You can sing worship songs and still worship your identity.
✔️ You can follow Jesus… as long as you’re still in charge.

📛 But at some point —
🔥 The cross confronts your crown.

💭 READER FINAL QUESTION:
"Brother John, what if I don’t feel ready to die to self yet?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then you’re in more danger than you realize.
📛 Readiness is not the standard.
🔥 Surrender is.

📖 John 12:24 (KJV):
“Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/John-12-24/

🔥 You were never meant to be improved.
You were meant to be buried… and reborn.

⚡ FINAL CHALLENGE STRIKE:
If you don’t die now, you may be forced to later — when grace is gone and judgment has begun.
🔥 Bow before your flesh betrays you again.
📛 Lay yourself on the altar — before God lays you bare in judgment.
FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE — WHO STILL WANTS TO LIVE?

📖 Proverbs 12:15 (KJV):
“The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Proverbs-12-15/

📖 Luke 14:27 (KJV):
“And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-14-27/
📛 You can’t carry your crown and your cross at the same time.
❌ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:
“God just wants me to be happy with myself.”
“Self-care is my first ministry.”
“God accepts me just as I am — I don’t need to change.”
“The cross is too extreme. That’s religious legalism.”
“I’ll work on myself — Jesus understands.”

🔥 Result:
The fool protects their image… and forfeits their soul.
✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:
“Jesus, I deny myself — all of it.”
“If You don’t kill the old me, I’ll live in deception.”
“I choose the altar, not the audience.”
“I don’t want comfort — I want crucifixion.”
“I am dead… and Christ is my only life now.”

🔥 Result:
The wise surrenders now — to be resurrected later.
"Brother John, I’ve been the fool. Can I still be counted among the wise?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes — if you bow today.
📛 Not with feelings.
🔥 With faith… and fire.

📖 Psalm 51:17 (KJV):
“A broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Psalms-51-17/

⚡ Summary Strike:
God isn’t asking for your best self.
🔥 He’s demanding your dead self — so He can raise a holy one in its place.

📛 The fool adjusts the Gospel.
🔥 The wise adjusts their life.
WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — WOULD HE FIND FRUIT… OR FLESH?

📖 Luke 9:24–25 (KJV):
“For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-9-24_9-25/

💥 You can win every goal, build every brand, post every quote —
🔥 and still lose your soul because you never lost yourself.

📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV):
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Hebrews-9-27/

📛 No warning.
No second chance.
🔥 Just the mirror of God — and whatever’s still alive in you.

📖 Matthew 7:22–23 (KJV):
“Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord… and then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-7-22_7-23/

💥 They preached. They posted. They prophesied.
📛 But they never died to self… so they never truly belonged to Christ.

💭 JUDGMENT QUESTION:
If you died tonight…
Would Heaven see a crucified man… or a polished influencer?
Would God find the image of Christ… or a resurrected ego?
Would you be carried into glory… or cast out for clinging to self?
🔥 Eternity has no space for self-worshipers. Only for the crucified.
"Brother John, I don’t want to die uncrucified… but I’m scared to surrender everything.”

✅ Direct Answer:
Fear means the cross is close.
📛 Don’t run. Bow.

📖 Romans 6:6 (KJV):
“Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Romans-6-6/

🔥 You’re not surrendering to death.
You’re surrendering to resurrection power — but it only comes after the funeral.

⚡ Summary Strike:
If you die tonight, and you’re still living for yourself…
📛 You’ll meet a Jesus you’ve never followed.
🔥 Die now — so you can live forever.
SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — WHEN SELF BECOMES THE SAVIOR
👿 1. The “Self-Love = God’s Love” Deception
“God just wants you to love yourself first. You can’t love others if you don’t love yourself.”

💀 Truth:
📛 The Gospel begins with self-denial, not self-prioritization.
🔥 Jesus didn’t say, “Love yourself more.”
He said, “Deny yourself.” (Luke 9:23)
👿 2. The “God Wants You to Be Your Best Self” Lie
“Jesus died so you could become everything you were meant to be!”

💀 Truth:
📖 You were “dead in trespasses and sins.” (Ephesians 2:1)
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ephesians-2-1/
🔥 Jesus didn’t come to enhance the old you.
He came to bury it… and resurrect His life inside you.
👿 3. The “Healing Before Holiness” Trap
“You can’t surrender until you’re emotionally healthy first.”

💀 Truth:
📛 Healing follows surrender — not the other way around.
🔥 The altar heals what the ego can’t.
👿 4. The “Don’t Be Too Intense” Muzzle
“You’re being too radical. Jesus was about grace, not dying to self every day.”

💀 Truth:
📖 Grace doesn’t cancel the cross — it empowers you to carry it. (Titus 2:11–12)
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Titus-2-11_2-12/
🔥 Grace that avoids crucifixion is not grace. It’s a trap.

📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 (KJV):
“And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Corinthians-11-14/

📛 Satan’s favorite disguise today?
🔥 A gospel of self-worth with a sprinkle of Scripture.
"Brother John, I’ve preached or reposted this false gospel without knowing. What now?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Repent publicly and urgently.
🔥 Don’t protect your past ignorance — expose it.

📖 Ephesians 5:11 (KJV):
“And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ephesians-5-11/

📛 Don’t repost soft fire.
🔥 Post the real Gospel — crucified and risen.

⚡ Summary Strike:
Satan isn’t just tempting the Church to sin.
🔥 He’s tempting her to self-preserve under the banner of grace.

📛 Hell doesn’t fear emotional Christians.
🔥 Hell fears crucified ones.
GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — I RENOUNCE SELF AND RECEIVE THE CROSS
📢 SAY THIS OUT LOUD — DON’T JUST READ IT. HELL MUST HEAR YOU. HEAVEN MUST MARK YOU.

“Jesus,
I renounce the gospel of self.
I reject the lie of self-love, self-worth, and self-exaltation.
I don’t want a better version of me — I want to be buried.

I surrender my ego, my brand, my need to be seen.
I refuse to be led by emotions or affirmed by culture.

I take up my cross — today, tomorrow, and until my last breath.
Kill what still lives in me.

I lay down every lie that said, ‘I am enough.’
I am not enough. Only You are.

Crucify my motives.
Crucify my opinions.
Crucify my image.
Let resurrection come — but only after the funeral.

I declare:
I am not alive unless I’m dead in You.
I don’t want success. I want surrender.
I don’t want to go viral. I want to go low.

I am no longer my own.
I belong to Christ — crucified, risen, and returning.

🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR —
Not because I feel strong, but because I’ve laid my flesh on the altar.
Not because I know who I am, but because I’ve died to who I was.

In the mighty name of Jesus Christ,
AMEN.”
📛 POST-READY DECLARATION (Use This on Facebook or Instagram):

👉 “I renounce the gospel of self. I choose crucifixion over comfort. I don’t want to be improved — I want to be buried and raised in Christ.
🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR.”
📎 Invite the remnant here:

🔥 Use tags:
#IAmCrucified
#GospelWarrior
#DeadToSelf
#SelfWillNotSaveYou
#TheRealGospelHurtsBeforeItHeals
"Brother John, what if I fail after saying this?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then fall again — on the cross, not on self-effort.
📛 You weren’t saved by being strong.
🔥 You were saved by staying surrendered.

📖 2 Corinthians 4:10 (KJV):
“Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Corinthians-4-10/
HOLY SPIRIT EMPOWERMENT DECREE — FILL WHAT SELF ONCE OCCUPIED
📢 SAY THIS OUT LOUD — LET HEAVEN POUR AND HELL TREMBLE:

“Holy Spirit,
Now that self is dead — come fill me.
Not with performance… but presence.
Not with charisma… but crucified fire.

Burn out the residue of self-will.
Cleanse the corners of my motives.
Possess what pride used to rule.

I don’t want to be a better person —
I want to be a Spirit-filled, fleshless, Christ-formed vessel.

Baptize me again in surrender.
Anoint me with oil the tare cannot counterfeit.
Fill me with a love that has no platform agenda.

Let the gifts flow — but only from death.
Let the joy rise — but only from holiness.
Let boldness roar — but only from brokenness.

I will not lead with self again.
I will not preach my trauma.
I will not build altars to my personality.

I receive Your power —
For obedience, for witness, for war.

Make me dangerous to Hell.
Make me useful to Heaven.
Make me invisible to pride… but unignorable in truth.

🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR —
Not because I’m louder… but because I’m filled.
Not because I’m bold… but because I’ve bowed.

In Jesus’ name,
AMEN.”

📖 Meditation Scripture — Luke 24:49 (KJV):
“And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-24-49/

📛 The promise isn’t for popularity.
🔥 It’s for power — after death, not before.
🕯️ POST-EMPOWERMENT INSTRUCTIONS:
🛑 Silence: 15 minutes — no music. Just say:
“Holy Spirit, rule me now.”

📝 Journal Entry Prompt:
Write what God burned, and what now fills its place.
Title it: “This Was Self. Now It’s Spirit.”

🎯 Acts-Based Action:
Preach one post publicly about what you’ve surrendered.
🔥 Don’t teach. Testify. Don’t polish. Proclaim.
"Brother John, what if I don’t feel anything after praying this?”

✅ Direct Answer:
🔥 The Spirit doesn’t fill you for feelings — He fills you for fruit.
📛 Trust the Word, not the emotion.
📖 Luke 11:13 — “how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-11-13/

⚡ Summary Strike:
You don’t need another feeling.
🔥 You need a filling… and you’ve asked in full surrender.
WARFARE ASSIGNMENT — THE SELFLESS WALK BEGINS NOW

🛡 1. Identify & Renounce One “Christian” Influencer or Resource That Exalts Self
📛 If it preaches “healing” with no cross…
📛 If it makes you love yourself more than deny yourself…
🔥 Remove it today. Post about it publicly. Expose it with grace and fire.

Example post:
“I followed this voice thinking it was biblical… but it exalted self. I’ve left it behind. I want the cross — not charisma.”
Use tag: #SelfIsNotMySavior
📖 2. Meditate on Galatians 2:20 Every Morning for 7 Days

“I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Galatians-2-20/

Write it on your mirror.
Read it aloud before your feet touch the floor.

🔥 You’re not waking up to “grind.”
You’re waking up… already dead.
📢 3. Post Your “Crucifixion Confession” on Social Media
Public repentance builds private strength.
👉 Suggested caption:

“I’ve preached the gospel of self. I’ve reposted lies dressed as love.
But today, I choose the cross. No more motivational deception.
I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR — crucified and rising.”

Tag with:
#TheOldMeIsDead
#GospelWarrior
#CrossOverCrowd
#IAmCrucified
#JesusOverSelf
📎 Remnant Link to include:
📞 4. Call or Message One Person You Know Is Caught in a Self-Focused Gospel
Not with judgment — with fire and grief.
🔥 Say:

“I used to follow that same path — but it’s killing the cross.
Let’s come back to Christ, not comfort.
Read Luke 9:23 with me… and let’s die together.”
🌱 5. Practice One Hidden Act of Surrender This Week (No One Can Know)
Examples:
Delete a platform you used for self-image
Fast from compliments and attention-seeking
Serve someone anonymously and deny your name
